messages:
Maya: quick watercooler poll — what's the weirdest /most unnecessary thing you've asked an LLM to roleplay? 😂
Jordan: asked one to write my wedding vows as if it were a pirate who also had mild anxiety. walked down the aisle slightly alarmed but moved. :sweat_smile:
Sam: once forced it to be my childhood cat (named Pickles). it refused to use pronouns, kept saying 'meow' between therapy metaphors. 10/10 for emotional support. :cat:
Priya: wrote an angry breakup email to my ficus. included bullet points, a breakup haiku, and a suggested playlist. plant didn't respond.
Ravi: made it generate office smalltalk scripts for when I run into the CEO in the elevator. includes escape hatch lines like 'oh wow, is that a new jacket? I love jackets.'
Jordan: also asked it to translate my commit messages into Shakespearean insults once. the repo history is now cursed.
Maya: omg I made it be my inner monologue coach but only in movie trailer voice. 'In a world where deadlines approach...' :laughing:
Sam: confession: i sometimes prompt it to pretend it's a barista who remembers my coffee order but gives unsolicited life advice. 
Priya: i ran an eval where the model had to impersonate a passive-aggressive office thermostat. it nailed the cold shoulder. 
Ravi: @Maya can you post that pirate vows sample? dying to see it.
Maya: sure — here's the top line I saved:
```
My heart be a brigantine, ye love be the map,
But I tremble like a landlubber at thunderclap.
```
Jordan: perfect. adding to the README under /docs/romance.md :joy:
memes-bot: :robot_face: top confessions so far — generating a meme summary... (thumbsup)
Maya: OK new rule — anyone who confesses a prompt that made them cry owes snacks to the channel.
Priya: that soundtrack playlist for ficus closure made me tear up. snacks incoming. :cookie:
Sam: i'll bring coffee and an apology cookie for Pickles.
Jordan: if anyone wants to privately share weird prompts for research (purely academic), dm me. i promise not to add Shakespearean curse lines to main branch.
Maya: this was fun, low-effort morale booster. carry on with your days, weird humans. :sparkles:
